C'est parfait, la capture d'écran montre exactement le problème !

L'erreur dans la console est :
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'style') at openModal

Cela signifie que dans ta fonction openModal, le code essaie de modifier le style d'un bouton (probablement le bouton "Supprimer" ou un autre élément) qui n'existe pas ou qui a été mal nommé dans ton fichier HTML.

La solution (à faire dans ton fichier HTML)

  1. Cherche la fonction function openModal(idx) {

  2. Regarde les premières lignes. Tu vas probablement trouver une ligne qui ressemble à ça :

javascript
Copier
Télécharger
document.getElementById('btn-suppr').style.display = idx >= 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';

(ou btn-supprimer, ou un autre ID de bouton)

  1. Vérifie que cet ID existe bien dans ton HTML. Si le bouton a été renommé, ou si l'ID a changé, ça plante.

Le correctif immédiat

Remplace toute la fonction openModal par celle-ci, qui est sécurisée (elle vérifie que les éléments existent avant de les modifier) :

javascript
Copier
Télécharger
function openModal(idx) {
  editLigne = -1;
  var c = idx >= 0 ? commandes[idx] : {};
  if (idx >= 0) editLigne = c.ligne;
  
  // Titre et bouton supprimer (sécurisé)
  var modalTitle = document.getElementById('modal-title');
  if (modalTitle) modalTitle.textContent = idx >= 0 ? 'Modifier - ' + str(c.client) : 'Nouvelle commande';
  
  var btnSuppr = document.getElementById('btn-suppr');
  if (btnSuppr) btnSuppr.style.display = idx >= 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
  
  // Champs standards
  ['client','devis','devisTTC','fournisseur','commande','arc','commentaireARC','prevLivraison','statutLivraison','statutPose'].forEach(function(f){ 
    var el = document.getElementById('f-' + f); 
    if (el) el.value = str(c[f]); 
  });
  
  // Options hors liste
  ajouterOptionHorsListe(document.getElementById('f-fournisseur'), c.fournisseur);
  ajouterOptionHorsListe(document.getElementById('f-commande'), c.commande);
  ajouterOptionHorsListe(document.getElementById('f-commentaireARC'), c.commentaireARC);
  ajouterOptionHorsListe(document.getElementById('f-statutLivraison'), c.statutLivraison);
  ajouterOptionHorsListe(document.getElementById('f-statutPose'), c.statutPose);
  
  // Valeurs spécifiques
  if (c.fournisseur) document.getElementById('f-fournisseur').value = str(c.fournisseur);
  if (c.commande) document.getElementById('f-commande').value = str(c.commande);
  if (c.commentaireARC) document.getElementById('f-commentaireARC').value = str(c.commentaireARC);
  if (c.statutLivraison) document.getElementById('f-statutLivraison').value = str(c.statutLivraison);
  if (c.statutPose) document.getElementById('f-statutPose').value = str(c.statutPose);
  
  var metEl = document.getElementById('f-metres');
  if (metEl) metEl.value = c.metres ? formatDateMetre(c.metres) : '';
  
  var pvEl = document.getElementById('f-pvChantier');
  if (pvEl) pvEl.checked = str(c.pvChantier).toUpperCase() === 'OUI';
  
  var dpEl = document.getElementById('f-datePose');
  if (dpEl) dpEl.value = str(c.datePose);
  
  var objEl = document.getElementById('f-objetCommande');
  if (objEl) objEl.value = str(c.objetCommande);
  
  var histEl = document.getElementById('f-commentaire-historique');
  if (histEl) histEl.value = str(c.commentaire);
  
  var cmtNouv = document.getElementById('f-commentaire-nouveau');
  if (cmtNouv) cmtNouv.value = '';
  
  // NOUVEAUX CHAMPS FINANCIERS
  var fAcompte = document.getElementById('f-acompte');
  if (fAcompte) fAcompte.value = str(c.acompte);
  
  var fReste = document.getElementById('f-resteAPayer');
  if (fReste) fReste.value = str(c.resteAPayer);
  
  var fFacture = document.getElementById('f-factureFournisseur');
  if (fFacture) fFacture.value = str(c.factureFournisseur);
  
  var fProforma = document.getElementById('f-alerteProforma');
  if (fProforma) fProforma.checked = (c.alerteProforma === true || c.alerteProforma === 'true');
  
  // Ouverture du modal
  var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('open');
}

3. Ajouter la gestion du "Ctrl+V" pour les images

Descends tout en bas de ton fichier (juste avant </script>), et ajoute ceci s'il n'y est pas déjà :

javascript
Copier
Télécharger
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var dropZone = document.getElementById('drop-zone');
  if (dropZone) {
    dropZone.addEventListener('paste', function(e) {
      var items = (e.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).items;
      for (var index in items) {
        var item = items[index];
        if (item.kind === 'file') {
          var blob = item.getAsFile();
          traiterImageDocument({ target: { files: [blob], value: '' } });
        }
      }
    });
    dropZone.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); 
  }
});

async function traiterImageDocument(e) {
  var file = e.target.files ? e.target.files[0] : null;
  if (!file) return;
  
  var status = document.getElementById('scan-status');
  status.style.display = 'block';
  status.style.color = "var(--bleu)";
  status.textContent = "⏳ Lecture du document en cours... (L'IA analyse l'image)";
  
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = async function(evt) {
    var base64Data = evt.target.result.split(',')[1];
    try {
      var r = await apiPost({ action: 'analyserDocument', imageBase64: base64Data, mimeType: file.type });
      if (r && r.ok && r.data) {
        if (r.data.acompte) document.getElementById('f-acompte').value = r.data.acompte;
        if (r.data.resteAPayer) document.getElementById('f-resteAPayer').value = r.data.resteAPayer;
        if (r.data.montantFournisseur) document.getElementById('f-factureFournisseur').value = r.data.montantFournisseur;
        if (r.data.demandeAcompte) document.getElementById('f-alerteProforma').checked = true;
        
        status.style.color = "var(--vert)";
        status.textContent = "✅ Analyse terminée avec succès !";
        afficherToast('ok', '✅', 'Document analysé', 'Les champs ont été remplis.', 3000);
      } else {
        throw new Error(r ? r.error : "Erreur de réponse");
      }
    } catch(err) {
      status.style.color = "var(--rouge)";
      status.textContent = "❌ Erreur : " + err.message;
    }
    if(e.target.value) e.target.value = '';
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

.filter-badge{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:all .15s;}
.filter-badge.all{border-color:var(--bleu);color:var(--bleu);background:var(--bleu-bg);}
.filter-badge.urgent{border-color:var(--rouge);color:var(--rouge);}
.filter-badge.warn{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange);}
.filter-badge.ok{border-color:var(--vert);color:var(--vert);}
.filter-badge.all.active{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.urgent.active{background:var(--rouge);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.warn.active{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.ok.active{background:var(--vert);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.sav-active{background:#D32F2F !important;color:#fff !important;}
.filter-badge.noncmd-active{background:#E65100 !important;color:#fff !important;}

/* ── TABLEAU OPTIMISÉ ── */
.table-wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 200px);display:block;width:100%;margin-bottom:15px;}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;}
thead th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--gris-bg);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--bordure);text-align:left;padding:8px 4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--texte2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
thead th:hover{color:var(--bleu);}
td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);vertical-align:middle;font-size:11px;}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr:hover td{background:#F8FBFF;}
.col-client{font-weight:600;min-width:100px;}
.col-mono{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--texte2);}
.col-comment{font-style:italic;color:var(--texte2);white-space:normal;min-width:80px;max-width:120px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;}
.badge-ok{background:var(--vert-bg);color:var(--vert);}
.badge-urgent{background:#FFEBEE;color:var(--rouge);}
.badge-info{background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);}
.alerte-text{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;white-space:normal;min-width:80px;max-width:120px;display:block;line-height:1.2;}
.alerte-ok{color:var(--vert);}.alerte-rouge{color:var(--rouge);}
.alerte-orange{color:var(--orange);}.alerte-jaune{color:#B7860B;}
.action-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:15px;}
.action-btn:hover{background:var(--gris-bg);}
.scroll-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2);padding:8px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bordure);}

/* ── AUTRES VUES ── */
.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:48px 24px;color:var(--texte2);}
.overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,20,40,.45);z-index:200;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.overlay.open{display:flex;}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;width:640px;max-width:96vw;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2);animation:fadeUp .2s ease;}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.modal-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 28px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.modal-header h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;}
.modal-close{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:var(--gris-bg);cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.modal-body{padding:22px 28px;}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
.form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
.form-group.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--texte2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;}
input,select,textarea{border:1.5px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 11px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s;color:var(--texte);}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--bleu);}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:70px;}
.modal-footer{padding:16px 28px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.saving-msg{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);display:none;}
.saving-msg.active{display:block;}
.alert-section{margin-bottom:22px;}
.alert-section-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--texte2);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.dot-badge{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;}
.alert-card{background:#fff;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;}
.alert-card:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
.alert-card-client{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:3px;}
.alert-card-detail{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);}
.alert-card-comment{font-size:12px;color:var(--bleu);font-style:italic;margin-top:4px;}
.alert-pill{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;align-self:flex-start;}
.dash-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;}
.dash-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:20px;}
.dash-card h4{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--texte2);margin-bottom:14px;}
.bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;}
.bar-label{width:110px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.bar-track{flex:1;height:8px;background:var(--bordure);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;}
.bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px;}
.bar-count{width:24px;text-align:right;color:var(--texte2);font-weight:600;}
.suivipose-card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;}
.suivipose-header{padding:14px 18px;background:var(--gris-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.suivipose-client{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;}
.suivipose-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2);}
.suivipose-body{padding:14px 18px;}
.suivipose-poseur{margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.suivipose-poseur:last-child{margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;border-bottom:none;}
.suivipose-poseur-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.suivipose-poseur-avatar{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;}
.suivipose-poseur-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;}
.suivipose-comment{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte);line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--gris-bg);border-radius:8px;border-left:3px solid var(--bleu);}
.suivipose-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);font-style:italic;padding:6px 0;}
.suivipose-date{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;z-index:500;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:380px;animation:slideIn .3s ease;border-left:4px solid var(--bleu);}
.toast.urgent{border-left-color:var(--rouge);}
.toast.warn{border-left-color:var(--orange);}
.toast.ok{border-left-color:var(--vert);}
.toast-icon{font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;}
.toast-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;}
.toast-msg{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);}
@keyframes slideIn{from{transform:translateX(120%);opacity:0}to{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1}}
.agent-header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1565C0,#0D47A1);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 28px;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}
.agent-header-info h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.agent-header-info p{font-size:13px;opacity:.85;}
.agent-header-date{font-size:12px;opacity:.7;margin-top:4px;}
.agent-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--bleu);border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:inherit;}
.agent-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.agent-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;transform:none;}
.agent-loader{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:var(--texte2);}
.agent-loader .spinner{display:inline-block;width:60px;height:60px;border:4px solid var(--bordure);border-top-color:var(--bleu);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 1s linear infinite;margin-bottom:16px;}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
.agent-loader .loader-msg{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--bleu);}
.agent-loader .loader-sub{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;}
.agent-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.agent-stat{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);text-align:center;}
.agent-stat-value{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;}
.agent-stat-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--texte2);margin-top:4px;}
.agent-resume{background:#F5F7FA;border-left:4px solid var(--bleu);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:18px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--texte);}
.agent-resume strong{color:var(--bleu);}
.agent-section{margin-bottom:24px;}
.agent-section-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.agent-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-left:4px solid;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;transition:box-shadow .15s;}
.agent-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.agent-card.sev-3{border-left-color:var(--rouge);}
.agent-card.sev-2{border-left-color:var(--orange);}
.agent-card.sev-1{border-left-color:var(--jaune);}
.agent-card-icon{font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;}
.agent-card-content{flex:1;}
.agent-card-client{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--texte);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.agent-card-ligne{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--texte2);background:var(--gris-bg);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;}
.agent-card-texte{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--texte);margin-bottom:8px;}
.agent-card-action{display:inline-block;background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;}
.agent-card-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;align-self:flex-start;}
.agent-card-btn{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;white-space:nowrap;}
.agent-card-btn:hover{background:var(--bleu-clair);}
.menu-burger{display:none;background:none;border:none;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--bleu);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1;}
.menu-mobile-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);z-index:400;animation:fadeIn .2s ease;}
.menu-mobile-overlay.open{display:flex;}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.menu-mobile-panel{background:#fff;width:280px;max-width:85vw;height:100%;overflow-y:auto;animation:slideInLeft .25s ease;}
@keyframes slideInLeft{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
.menu-mobile-header{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;padding:20px 22px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.menu-mobile-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 22px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);transition:background .15s;color:var(--texte);}
.menu-mobile-item:hover{background:var(--bleu-bg);}
.menu-mobile-item .icon{font-size:22px;width:28px;text-align:center;}

/* ── RESPONSIVE MOBILE ── */
@media(max-width:900px){
.sidebar{width:52px;}
.sidebar .nav-item span,.sidebar-logo span,.sidebar-logo small,.sidebar-footer{display:none;}
.sidebar-logo #version-info{display:none;}
.main{margin-left:52px;width:calc(100% - 52px);}
.sidebar-logo{padding:14px 8px;}
.nav-item{padding:14px 8px;justify-content:center;}
.nav-item .icon{font-size:20px;}
.agent-header{padding:16px 18px;}
.agent-header-info h2{font-size:16px;}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
.sidebar{display:none !important;}
.main{margin-left:0 !important;width:100% !important;}
.menu-burger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.topbar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;}
.topbar-title{flex:1;font-size:15px;}
.topbar-right{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.topbar-right .btn{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex:1;min-width:80px;}
.content{padding:10px 12px;}
.filters-bar{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:10px;}
.search-input,.select-filter{width:100%;}
.filter-badge{flex:1;min-width:70px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;padding:6px 8px;}
.kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);gap:8px;}
.kpi-card{padding:12px;}
.kpi-value{font-size:22px;}
.table-wrap{overflow:visible;}

table:not(.no-responsive) thead{display:none;}
table:not(.no-responsive), table:not(.no-responsive) tbody, table:not(.no-responsive) tr, table:not(.no-responsive) td{display:block;width:100%;}
table:not(.no-responsive) tr{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);margin-bottom:10px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
table:not(.no-responsive) td{border:none;padding:5px 0;text-align:left !important;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:normal;}
table:not(.no-responsive) td::before{content:attr(data-label);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texte2);flex-shrink:0;}
table:not(.no-responsive) td:first-child{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--bleu);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:4px;}
table:not(.no-responsive) td:first-child::before{display:none;}
.col-comment{max-width:none !important;white-space:normal !important;}

table.no-responsive { display: table !important; width: 100% !important; }
table.no-responsive thead { display: table-header-group !important; }
table.no-responsive tbody { display: table-row-group !important; }
table.no-responsive tr { display: table-row !important; margin-bottom: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; border-radius: 0 !important; background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: none !important; }
table.no-responsive th, table.no-responsive td { display: table-cell !important; text-align: center !important; border: 1px solid var(--bordure) !important; padding: 6px 4px !important; font-size: 11px !important; white-space: nowrap !important; }
table.no-responsive td::before { display: none !important; }
table.no-responsive td:first-child { font-size: 11px !important; font-weight: bold !important; color: var(--texte) !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bordure) !important; background: transparent !important; }

.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
#planning-titre{font-size:14px;}
.agent-card{flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.agent-card-actions{width:100%;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.agent-card-btn{flex:1;padding:8px;font-size:13px;}
}

/* ── SOUS-MODULES TACHES & ACHATS ── */
.stock-subtabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 14px}
.stock-subtab{border:1px solid #CFD8DC;background:#fff;color:var(--texte);padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.stock-subtab.active{background:var(--bleu);border-color:var(--bleu);color:#fff}
.buy-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}

.buy-card{border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-left:4px solid #E65100;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;margin-top:10px;background:#fff}
.buy-card.buy-late{border-left-color:#D32F2F;background:#FFF8F8}
.buy-card.buy-received{border-left-color:#2E7D32;opacity:.8}
.buy-card-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:750;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.buy-card-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.buy-chip{display:inline-flex;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;background:#ECEFF1;color:#455A64}

.buy-chip.ordered{background:#E3F2FD;color:#1565C0}
.buy-chip.received{background:#E8F5E9;color:#2E7D32}
.buy-card-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.buy-stats .task-stat{min-width:0}

.task-nav-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:18px;height:18px;padding:0 5px;margin-left:auto;border-radius:10px;background:#D32F2F;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;}
.task-nav-badge:empty{display:none}
.task-intro{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:#E3F2FD;border:1px solid #BBDEFB;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;color:#164777;font-size:12px}
.task-intro strong{font-size:14px}
.task-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.task-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:10px;padding:12px}
.task-stat strong{display:block;font-size:23px}
.task-stat span{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2)}
.task-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,0.85fr) minmax(320px,1.5fr);gap:14px;align-items:start}
.task-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;min-width:0}
.task-panel h3{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.task-panel label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--texte2);margin:11px 0 5px}
.task-input{width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #CDD8E3;border-radius:7px;background:#fff;font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--texte);min-width:0}
.task-input:focus{outline:2px solid #BBDEFB;border-color:var(--bleu)}
textarea.task-input{resize:vertical}
.task-fields-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.task-form-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.task-list-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.task-list-head h3{margin-bottom:0}
.task-filters{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.task-filters .task-input{width:auto;max-width:180px}
.task-action{border:1px solid #CFD8DC;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}
.task-action:hover{background:#F5F7FA}
.task-empty{padding:28px 12px;text-align:center;color:var(--texte2);font-size:12px}
.task-card-details{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--texte2);white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:7px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:900px){.task-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.task-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.task-list-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.task-filters{width:100%}.task-filters .task-input{flex:1;max-width:none}}

/* ── FLOTTE (MODE ALERTES) ── */
.flotte-alerte-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-left:4px solid;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
.flotte-alerte-card.urgent{border-left-color:var(--rouge);}
.flotte-alerte-card.warn{border-left-color:var(--orange);}
.flotte-alerte-titre{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--texte);margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.flotte-alerte-liste{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--texte2);margin-top:6px;font-size:13px;}
.flotte-alerte-liste li{margin-bottom:6px;line-height: 1.4;}
.flotte-ok-item{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;opacity:1;}
.flotte-details-box {font-size: 11px; background: #F5F7FA; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; margin-top: 8px; color: #546E7A; display: block; border-left: 3px solid #90CAF9;}
</style>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>

<div class="menu-mobile-overlay" id="menu-mobile" onclick="fermerMenuMobile(event)">
  <div class="menu-mobile-panel" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="menu-mobile-header"><span>📋 Navigation</span><button onclick="fermerMenuMobile()" style="background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;">✕</button></div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('suivi')"><span class="icon">📋</span> Commandes</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('alertes')"><span class="icon">🔔</span> Alertes</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('taches')"><span class="icon">📝</span> Tâches & Consommables <span id="taches-badge-mobile" class="task-nav-badge"></span></div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('agent')"><span class="icon">🤖</span> Agent IA</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('metre')"><span class="icon">📅</span> Dates Métré</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('dashboard')"><span class="icon">📊</span> Dashboard</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('flotte')"><span class="icon">🚗</span> Flotte</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('suivipose')"><span class="icon">🔨</span> Suivi Pose</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('planning')"><span class="icon">📅</span> Planning</div>
    <div class="menu-mobile-item" onclick="menuMobileGo('config')"><span class="icon">⚙️</span> Config</div>
  </div>
</div>

<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-logo"><span>ECO OUEST</span><small>Suivi Commandes</small><div id="version-info" style="font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#FFD600;background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:6px;">v15.0</div></div>
  <nav class="nav">
    <div class="nav-item active" id="nav-suivi" onclick="showView('suivi')"><span class="icon">📋</span><span>Commandes</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-alertes" onclick="showView('alertes')"><span class="icon">🔔</span><span>Alertes</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-taches" onclick="showView('taches')"><span class="icon">📝</span><span>Tâches & Consommables</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-agent" onclick="showView('agent')"><span class="icon">🤖</span><span>Agent IA</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-metre" onclick="showView('metre')"><span class="icon">📅</span><span>Dates Métré</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-dashboard" onclick="showView('dashboard')"><span class="icon">📊</span><span>Dashboard</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-flotte" onclick="showView('flotte')"><span class="icon">🚗</span><span>Flotte</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-suivipose" onclick="showView('suivipose')"><span class="icon">🔨</span><span>Suivi Pose</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-planning" onclick="showView('planning')"><span class="icon">📅</span><span>Planning</span></div>
    <div class="nav-item" id="nav-config" onclick="showView('config')"><span class="icon">⚙️</span><span>Config</span></div>
  </nav>
  <div class="sidebar-footer">v15.0</div>
</aside>

<div class="main">
  <div class="topbar">
    <button class="menu-burger" id="menu-burger" onclick="ouvrirMenuMobile()" title="Menu">☰</button>
    <span class="topbar-title" id="topbar-title">Suivi des commandes</span>
    <div class="topbar-right">
      <span class="sync-info"><span class="sync-dot" id="sync-dot"></span><span id="sync-label">Chargement...</span></span>
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" id="btn-notif" onclick="activerNotifications()" title="Notifications">🔕 Notifs</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="actualiserTout()">🔄 Actualiser</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="exportCSV()">⬇ CSV</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="ouvrirModalDictee()" style="border-color:#E65100;color:#E65100;">🎙️ Dicter</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="openModal(-1)">+ Nouvelle commande</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="content">
    <div class="loader-bar" id="loader"><div class="loader-fill"></div></div>
    
    <div id="view-suivi" class="view active">
      <div class="kpi-grid" id="kpi-grid"></div>
      <div class="filters-bar">
        <input type="text" class="search-input" id="search" placeholder="🔍 Rechercher client, devis, ARC..." oninput="renderTable()">
        <select class="select-filter" id="filter-fournisseur" onchange="renderTable()"><option value="">Tous fournisseurs</option></select>
        <select class="select-filter" id="filter-statut" onchange="renderTable()">
          <option value="">Tous statuts</option>
          <option>A planifier</option><option>A PLANIFIER</option><option>Livré</option><option>En cours</option><option>SAV</option><option>Terminé</option><option>Posé</option><option>Annulé</option><option>En attente</option><option>Bloqué</option>
        </select>
        <label style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--texte2);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;"><input type="checkbox" id="show-termines" onchange="renderTable()" style="width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer;">Voir terminés</label>
        <span class="filter-badge all active" id="fb-all" onclick="setFilter('all')">Toutes</span>
        <span class="filter-badge urgent" id="fb-urgent" onclick="setFilter('urgent')">🔴 Urgentes</span>
        <span class="filter-badge warn" id="fb-warn" onclick="setFilter('warn')">🟠 Attention</span>
        <span class="filter-badge ok" id="fb-ok" onclick="setFilter('ok')">🟢 OK</span>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:8px;">
        <span class="filter-badge" id="fb-sav" onclick="setFilter('sav')" style="border:1.5px solid #D32F2F;color:#D32F2F;font-weight:700;flex:1;text-align:center;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;">🔧 SAV (<span id="sav-count">0</span>)</span>
        <span class="filter-badge" id="fb-noncmd" onclick="setFilter('noncmd')" style="border:1.5px solid #E65100;color:#E65100;font-weight:700;flex:1;text-align:center;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;">📦 Non commandé (<span id="noncmd-count">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table><thead><tr>
          <th onclick="sortBy('client')">Client ↕</th><th onclick="sortBy('fournisseur')">Fournisseur ↕</th><th onclick="sortBy('metres')">📅 Métré ↕</th><th>N° Devis</th><th>Commande</th><th>ARC</th><th onclick="sortBy('prevLivraison')">Livraison ↕</th><th>Statut livraison</th><th>Statut pose</th><th>Date pose</th><th>PV Chantier</th><th>Commentaire</th><th>Alerte</th><th></th>
        </tr></thead><tbody id="table-body"></tbody></table>
        <div class="scroll-hint" id="scroll-hint"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="view-alertes" class="view"><div style="background:#FFF8E1;border:1px solid #FFE082;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:12px;color:#6D4C41;"><strong>Priorité bureau :</strong> traiter d'abord les SAV et commandes non envoyées, puis les livraisons dépassées et les ARC manquants.</div><div id="alertes-content"></div></div>

    <div id="view-taches" class="view">
      <div class="stock-subtabs">
        <button type="button" id="tab-taches-notes" class="stock-subtab active" onclick="ouvrirSousModuleTaches('taches')">📝 Tâches & Notes</button>
        <button type="button" id="tab-achats-consommables" class="stock-subtab" onclick="ouvrirSousModuleTaches('achats')">🛒 Achats consommables <span id="achats-badge" class="task-nav-badge"></span></button>
      </div>
      
      <div id="sousmodule-taches-notes">
        <div class="task-intro"><strong>📝 Tâches & notes du bureau</strong><span>Consignez un rappel, une relance fournisseur, une action SAV ou une note utile.</span></div>
        
        <div class="buy-stats" id="taches-stats"></div>
        
        <div class="buy-layout">
          <section class="task-panel">
            <h3 id="task-form-title">＋ Ajouter une tâche ou une note</h3>
            <form id="task-form" onsubmit="enregistrerTache(event)">
              <input type="hidden" id="task-id">
              <label for="task-type">Type</label>
              <select id="task-type" class="task-input"><option value="tache">📝 Tâche à faire</option><option value="note">🗒️ Note / information</option></select>
              
              <label for="task-title">Titre (ou contenu de la tâche) *</label>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:6px;">
                <input id="task-title" class="task-input" maxlength="140" required placeholder="Ex. Relancer le fournisseur">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="dicterPourChamp('task-title')" title="Dicter le titre" style="padding:0 10px; border-color:#E65100; color:#E65100;">🎤</button>
              </div>
              
              <label for="task-details">Détails (ou contenu de la note)</label>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:flex-start;">
                <textarea id="task-details" class="task-input" rows="3" maxlength="3000" placeholder="Informations complémentaires..."></textarea>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="dicterPourChamp('task-details')" title="Dicter les détails" style="padding:8px 10px; border-color:#E65100; color:#E65100;">🎤</button>
              </div>
              
              <div class="task-fields-row">
                <div><label for="task-echeance">Échéance</label><input id="task-echeance" class="task-input" type="date"></div>
                <div><label for="task-priorite">Priorité</label><select id="task-priorite" class="task-input"><option value="haute">🔴 Haute</option><option value="normale" selected>🟠 Normale</option><option value="basse">🟢 Basse</option></select></div>
              </div>

              <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline" onclick="dicterPourChamp('task-details')" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 15px; padding: 12px; border-color: #E65100; color: #E65100; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;">🎤 Dicter la note / les détails à la voix</button>

              <div class="task-form-actions" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">💾 Enregistrer</button>
                <button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" onclick="reinitialiserFormTache()">Annuler</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </section>
          
          <section class="task-panel">
            <div class="task-list-head">
              <h3>📌 Tâches et notes</h3>
              <div class="task-filters">
                <select id="task-filter-type" class="task-input" onchange="renderTaches()"><option value="toutes">Tout afficher</option><option value="taches">Tâches uniquement</option><option value="notes">Notes uniquement</option></select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="taches-list"></div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div id="sousmodule-achats-consommables" style="display:none">
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="afficherInventaireComplet()" style="border-color:#1565C0;color:#1565C0;">📖 Voir l'inventaire complet</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="capturerAchatsEnCours()" style="border-color:#E65100;color:#E65100;">📸 Capture (En cours)</button>
          <span id="catalogue-alerte" style="display:none;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="task-intro" style="background:#FFF8E1;border-color:#FFE082;color:#6D4C41"><strong>🛒 Achats consommables</strong><span>Listez les consommables à acheter. Utilisez l'inventaire pour pré-remplir les articles.</span></div>
        <div class="buy-stats" id="achats-stats"></div>
        <div class="buy-layout">
          <section class="task-panel">
            <h3 id="achat-form-title">＋ Ajouter un consommable</h3>
            <form id="achat-form" onsubmit="enregistrerAchatConsommable(event)"><input type="hidden" id="achat-id">
              <label for="achat-nom">Article / consommable *</label>
              <input id="achat-nom" class="task-input" maxlength="140" required placeholder="Tapez un code, une désignation ou un fournisseur…" list="datalist-catalogue" oninput="rechercherArticle()" onchange="prefillAchatDepuisCatalogue()">
              <datalist id="datalist-catalogue"></datalist>
              <div id="achat-info-stock" style="display:none;padding:8px 12px;background:#F5F7FA;border-left:3px solid #1565C0;border-radius:6px;margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;"></div>
              <div class="task-fields-row"><div><label for="achat-reference">Référence catalogue</label><input id="achat-reference" class="task-input" maxlength="40" placeholder="Auto-rempli" readonly style="background:#F0F4F8;"></div><div><label for="achat-quantite">Quantité *</label><input id="achat-quantite" class="task-input" required maxlength="60" placeholder="Ex. 10 cartouches"></div></div>
              <label for="achat-categorie">Catégorie</label><select id="achat-categorie" class="task-input"><option>Quincaillerie</option><option>Fixations</option><option>Étanchéité</option><option>Protection / EPI</option><option>Outillage</option><option>Bureau</option><option>Autre</option></select>
              <label for="achat-fournisseur">Fournisseur</label><input id="achat-fournisseur" class="task-input" maxlength="120">
              <div class="task-fields-row"><div><label for="achat-echeance">À acheter avant le</label><input id="achat-echeance" class="task-input" type="date"></div><div><label for="achat-priorite">Priorité</label><select id="achat-priorite" class="task-input"><option value="haute">🔴 Haute</option><option value="normale" selected>🟠 Normale</option><option value="basse">🟢 Basse</option></select></div></div>
              <label for="achat-statut">Statut</label><select id="achat-statut" class="task-input"><option value="a-acheter">À acheter</option><option value="commande">Commandé</option><option value="recu">Reçu</option></select>
              <label for="achat-notes">Notes / référence / chantier</label><textarea id="achat-notes" class="task-input" rows="3" maxlength="1500"></textarea>
              <div class="task-form-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">💾 Enregistrer</button><button class="btn btn-outline" type="button" onclick="reinitialiserFormAchat()">Annuler</button></div>
            </form>
          </section>
          <section class="task-panel">
            <div class="task-list-head"><h3>📦 Liste des achats</h3><div class="task-filters"><select id="achat-filtre" class="task-input" onchange="renderAchatsConsommables()"><option value="ouverts">À acheter / commandés</option><option value="tous">Tous les achats</option><option value="a-acheter">À acheter</option><option value="commande">Commandés</option><option value="recu">Reçus</option><option value="retard">En retard</option></select></div></div>
            <div id="achats-list"></div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="view-agent" class="view">
      <div class="agent-header">
        <div class="agent-header-info"><h2>🤖 Agent IA de suivi</h2><p>Analyse intelligente</p><div class="agent-header-date" id="agent-date">Dernière analyse : —</div></div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="agent-btn" onclick="ouvrirAssistantVocal()" style="background:#E65100;color:#fff;">🎤 Poser une question</button>
          <button class="agent-btn" onclick="ouvrirActionVocale()" style="background:#2E7D32;color:#fff;">🗣️ Commande d'action</button>
          <button class="agent-btn" id="btn-analyser" onclick="lancerAnalyse()"><span id="btn-analyser-icon">✨</span><span id="btn-analyser-text">Analyser</span></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="agent-content"><div class="empty-state"><div style="font-size:64px;margin-bottom:16px;">🤖</div><h3 style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;">Agent IA prêt</h3><p>Cliquez sur Analyser ou utilisez les boutons vocaux.</p></div></div>
    </div>

    <div id="view-metre" class="view">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;"><input type="text" id="metre-search" placeholder="🔍 Rechercher..." oninput="renderMetre()" class="search-input"><select id="metre-filter" onchange="renderMetre()" class="select-filter"><option value="">Toutes</option><option value="rempli">Date renseignée</option><option value="vide">Date manquante</option></select></div>
      <div id="metre-stats" class="kpi-grid"></div>
      <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Ligne</th><th>Client</th><th>Fournisseur</th><th>N° Devis</th><th>📅 Date métré</th><th>Statut livraison</th><th>Statut pose</th><th>Alerte</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="metre-table-body"></tbody></table><div class="scroll-hint" id="metre-scroll-hint"></div></div>
    </div>

    <div id="view-dashboard" class="view"><div class="dash-grid" id="dash-content"></div></div>

    <div id="view-flotte" class="view">
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:15px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;">
        <h3 style="font-size:16px; margin:0; color:var(--bleu);">État de la flotte</h3>
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="ouvrirModalVehicule()">+ Ajouter / Modifier un véhicule</button>
      </div>
      <div id="flotte-alertes" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;"></div>
      <div id="flotte-ok-list" style="display:block; margin-top:20px;"></div>
      <button id="btn-toggle-ok" style="display:none;"></button>
    </div>

    <div id="view-suivipose" class="view"><div style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:10px;"><button onclick="traduireCommentairesPoseurs()" style="background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);border:1px solid var(--bleu);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">🇫🇷 Traduire les commentaires</button></div><div id="suivipose-content"></div></div>
    
    <div id="view-planning" class="view">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button onclick="planningSemaine(-1)" style="background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">← Sem. préc.</button>
        <div id="planning-titre" style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;flex:1;text-align:center;min-width:100px;"></div>
        <button onclick="planningSemaine(1)" style="background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Sem. suiv. →</button>
        <button onclick="planningSemaine(0)" style="background:var(--gris-bg);color:var(--texte);border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Aujourd'hui</button>
      </div>
      <div id="planning-content"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="view-config" class="view">
      <div style="max-width:540px;"><div style="background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:24px;">
        <h3 style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;">⚙️ Configuration</h3>
        <div style="margin-bottom:14px;"><label style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texte2);display:block;margin-bottom:6px;">URL Web App</label><input type="text" id="config-url-input" style="width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;"></div>
        <button onclick="sauvegarderConfig()" class="btn btn-primary" style="width:100%;">💾 Enregistrer et reconnecter</button>
        <div id="config-status" style="margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;text-align:center;"></div>
        <div style="margin-top:20px;padding:14px;background:var(--gris-bg);border-radius:8px;"><p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;">URL actuelle :</p><p id="config-url-current" style="font-size:11px;word-break:break-all;font-family:monospace;"></p></div>
      </div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="overlay" id="overlay" onclick="closeOut(event)"><div class="modal">
  <div class="modal-header"><h3 id="modal-title">Nouvelle commande</h3><button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()">✕</button></div>
  <div class="modal-body"><div class="form-grid">
    <div class="form-group"><label>Client *</label><input id="f-client" type="text"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Fournisseur</label><select id="f-fournisseur"><option value="">— Choisir —</option></select></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>📅 Date métré</label><input id="f-metres" type="text" placeholder="31/08/2026"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>N° Devis</label><input id="f-devis" type="text"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Devis TTC</label><input id="f-devisTTC" type="number"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Commande envoyée</label><select id="f-commande"><option value="">—</option><option>OUI</option><option>NON</option></select></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>N° ARC</label><input id="f-arc" type="text"></div>
    <div class="form-group full"><label>📦 Objet</label><textarea id="f-objetCommande" style="min-height:50px;"></textarea></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Validation ARC</label><select id="f-commentaireARC"><option value="">—</option><option>Confirmer</option><option>Valide</option><option>En attente</option><option>ANNULER</option></select></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Prévision livraison</label><input id="f-prevLivraison" type="text"></div>

<script>
var WEBAPP_DEFAULT = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzcq9ChzAPdH1DWnH5H-cYBVC_8Ou4DVIy1sKES5PyFC0M3j80RrbnUU8fK8ojL013H/exec';
var WEBAPP = localStorage.getItem('eco-webapp-url') || WEBAPP_DEFAULT;
var FOU_COLORS = {'ATLANTEM':'#1565C0','ATULAM':'#6A1B9A','LALLEMANT':'#2E7D32','SOKO':'#00695C','ALUGLASS':'#E65100','FILTERSUN':'#C62828','DC PROD':'#37474F','KE FRANCE':'#0277BD','SKYLUX':'#558B2F','BVL SERRULAC':'#4527A0','LEROY MERLIN':'#1B5E20','FOUSSIER':'#6D4C41','STOCK':'#546E7A'};
var TERMINES = ['livre','termine','pose'];
var commandes = [];
var sortCol = 'ligne', sortAsc = false, alertFilter = 'all', editLigne = -1;
var CACHE_DUREE = 60 * 1000, CACHE_KEY = 'eco-ouest-cache-v150', CACHE_TIME_KEY = 'eco-ouest-cache-time-v150';
var dernierRapportAgent = null;
var recognition = null, recognitionAssistant = null, recognitionAction = null;
var cacheTrad = {};
var catalogueConsommables = [];
var tachesNotes = [];
var achatsConsommables = [];
var flotteVehicules = [];

function nettoyerTextePourVoix(texte) { if (!texte) return ""; return texte.replace(/\*\*/g,'').replace(/\*/g,'').replace(/#/g,'').replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/`/g,'').replace(/•/g,', '); }
function str(s) { if (s === null || s === undefined) return ''; return String(s); }
function normaliserStatutUI(v) { return str(v).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim().toLowerCase(); }
function estTermineStatut(v) { return TERMINES.indexOf(normaliserStatutUI(v)) !== -1; }
function h(s) { return str(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }
function escAttr(s) { return h(s); }
function estAnnulee(c) { var ANN = ['ANNULER','ANNULE','ANNULÉ']; return ANN.indexOf(str(c.commentaireARC).trim().toUpperCase()) !== -1 || ANN.indexOf(str(c.statutLivraison).trim().toUpperCase()) !== -1 || ANN.indexOf(str(c.statutPose).trim().toUpperCase()) !== -1; }
function afficherToast(type, icon, titre, msg, duree) { var e = document.querySelector('.toast'); if (e) e.remove(); duree = duree || 4000; var t = document.createElement('div'); t.className = 'toast ' + type; t.innerHTML = '<span class="toast-icon">'+icon+'</span><div style="flex:1"><div class="toast-title">'+h(titre)+'</div><div class="toast-msg">'+h(msg||'')+'</div></div>'; document.body.appendChild(t); setTimeout(function(){ t.style.opacity='0'; t.style.transition='opacity .3s'; setTimeout(function(){t.remove();},300); }, duree); }
function ouvrirMenuMobile() { var m = document.getElementById('menu-mobile'); if (m) m.classList.add('open'); }
function fermerMenuMobile(e) { if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation(); var m = document.getElementById('menu-mobile'); if (m) m.classList.remove('open'); }
function menuMobileGo(v) { fermerMenuMobile(); showView(v); }
function formatDateMetre(val) { if (!val) return ''; if (typeof val === 'string' && !/GMT|T\d{2}:/.test(val) && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(val)) return str(val).trim(); try { var d = (val instanceof Date) ? val : new Date(val); if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return str(val).trim(); return d.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', {weekday:'long', day:'numeric', month:'long'}); } catch(e) { return str(val).trim(); } }
function convertirEnDateISO(s) { if (!s) return ''; s = str(s).trim(); if (!s) return ''; var y, mo, d, m; if ((m = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/))) { y=+m[1]; mo=+m[2]; d=+m[3]; return dateCalendrierValide(y,mo,d)?s:''; } m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{2,4})$/); if (m) { d=+m[1]; mo=+m[2]; y=+m[3]; if (y<100) y+=2000; if (!dateCalendrierValide(y,mo,d)) return ''; return String(y).padStart(4,'0')+'-'+String(mo).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d).padStart(2,'0'); } var moisFR = {'janvier':1,'fevrier':2,'février':2,'mars':3,'avril':4,'mai':5,'juin':6,'juillet':7,'aout':8,'août':8,'septembre':9,'octobre':10,'novembre':11,'decembre':12,'décembre':12}; m = s.toLowerCase().match(/(\d{1,2})[,\s]+([a-zà-ÿ]+)(?:\s+(\d{4}))?/); if (m) { d=+m[1]; mo=moisFR[m[2]]; y=m[3]?+m[3]:new Date().getFullYear(); if (mo && dateCalendrierValide(y,mo,d)) return String(y)+'-'+String(mo).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d).padStart(2,'0'); } return ''; }
function dateCalendrierValide(a,m,j) { var d = new Date(a, m-1, j); return d.getFullYear()===a && d.getMonth()===m-1 && d.getDate()===j; }
function parseDatePose(dp) { if (!dp) return null; dp = str(dp).trim(); if (!dp) return null; var mSem = dp.match(/^S\s*0*(\d{1,2})$/i); if (mSem) { var num = parseInt(mSem[1], 10); if (num>=1 && num<=53) return { type:'semaine', num: num }; } var mDate = dp.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{2,4})$/); if (mDate) { var jour=parseInt(mDate[1],10), mois=parseInt(mDate[2],10), annee=parseInt(mDate[3],10); if (annee<100) annee+=2000; if (!dateCalendrierValide(annee,mois,jour)) return null; return { type:'date', date: new Date(annee,mois-1,jour) }; } if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dp)) { var iso=dp.split('-').map(Number); if (!dateCalendrierValide(iso[0],iso[1],iso[2])) return null; return { type:'date', date: new Date(iso[0],iso[1]-1,iso[2]) }; } var dISO = new Date(dp); if (!isNaN(dISO.getTime())) return { type:'date', date: dISO }; return null; }
function statutEstSAV(v) { return normaliserStatutUI(v) === 'sav'; }
function dateLivraisonDepassee(c, auj) { var st = normaliserStatutUI(c.statutLivraison); if (st==='livre'||st==='termine'||st==='annule') return false; if (estTermineStatut(c.statutPose)) return false; var iso = convertirEnDateISO(c.prevLivraison); if (!iso) return false; var p = iso.split('-').map(Number); var dateLiv = new Date(p[0],p[1]-1,p[2]); var ref = auj instanceof Date ? new Date(auj.getFullYear(),auj.getMonth(),auj.getDate()) : new Date(); ref = new Date(ref.getFullYear(),ref.getMonth(),ref.getDate()); return dateLiv.getTime() < ref.getTime(); }
function alerte(c, auj) { var sL=str(c.statutLivraison).trim(), sP=str(c.statutPose).trim(); if (estAnnulee(c)) return {t:'Annulée',n:-1}; if (statutEstSAV(sL)||statutEstSAV(sP)) return {t:'SAV en cours - ACTION REQUISE',n:3}; if (estTermineStatut(sL)||estTermineStatut(sP)) return {t:'OK',n:0}; var m=[], s=0; if (!c.commande || str(c.commande).trim().toUpperCase()!=='OUI'){m.push('Commande non envoyée - URGENT');s=3;} if (dateLivraisonDepassee(c, auj)){m.push('Date de livraison dépassée - URGENT');s=3;} if (!c.arc || !str(c.arc).trim()){m.push('ARC non reçu');if(s<2)s=2;} if (!c.commentaireARC || !str(c.commentaireARC).trim()){m.push('Validation ARC manquante');if(s<2)s=2;} else if (normaliserStatutUI(c.commentaireARC).indexOf('en attente')!==-1){m.push('En attente ARC');if(s<2)s=2;} if (!c.prevLivraison || !str(c.prevLivraison).trim()){m.push('Date livraison manquante');if(s<1)s=1;} if (!m.length) return {t:'OK',n:0}; return {t:m.join(' | '),n:s}; }
function pvBadge(val, ligne) { var fait = val && str(val).toUpperCase() === 'OUI'; return '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;"><input type="checkbox" '+(fait?'checked':'')+' onchange="togglePV('+ligne+', this.checked)" style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--vert);cursor:pointer;"><span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:'+(fait?'var(--vert)':'var(--texte2)')+';">'+(fait?'✓ Fait':'Non fait')+'</span></label>'; }
async function togglePV(ligne, checked) { var val = checked?'OUI':'NON'; var c = commandes.find(function(x){return x.ligne===ligne;}); var ancien = c?c.pvChantier:''; if (c) c.pvChantier = val; renderTable(); try { var r = await apiPost({action:'modifier', ligne:ligne, clientAttendu: c?c.client:undefined, champs:{16: val}}); if (!r||!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error||'Erreur'); afficherToast('ok','✅','PV mis à jour','',2000); sauvegarderCache(commandes); } catch(e) { if (c) c.pvChantier = ancien; renderTable(); afficherToast('urgent','⚠️','Erreur PV', e.message, 5000); } }
function semaineBadge(s) { if (!s||!str(s).trim()) return '<span style="color:#ccc">—</span>'; var m = str(s).trim().match(/S\s*0*(\d{1,2})/i); if (m) { var num = parseInt(m[1],10), cw = getWeekNumber(new Date()), color = '#1565C0', bg = '#E3F2FD'; if (num<cw) {color='#D32F2F';bg='#FFEBEE';} else if (num===cw) {color='#E65100';bg='#FFF3E0';} else if (num<=cw+2) {color='#F9A825';bg='#FFFDE7';} else {color='#2E7D32';bg='#E8F5E9';} return '<span class="badge" style="background:'+bg+';color:'+color+';font-weight:700;">S'+num+'</span>'; } return '<span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);">'+h(s)+'</span>'; }
function getWeekNumber(d) { d = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate())); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - (d.getUTCDay()||7)); var ys = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),0,1)); return Math.ceil((((d-ys)/86400000)+1)/7); }
function aClass(n) { return n===0?'alerte-ok':n===1?'alerte-jaune':n===2?'alerte-orange':n===3?'alerte-rouge':''; }

async function apiPost(body, tentative) {
  tentative = tentative || 1;
  var delai = (body && body.action === 'analyserAgent') ? 90000 : 60000;
  var timeoutId = null;
  try {
    var controller = new AbortController();
    timeoutId = setTimeout(function(){ controller.abort(); }, delai);
    var r = await fetch(WEBAPP, { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain;charset=utf-8'}, body:JSON.stringify(body), redirect:'follow', signal:controller.signal });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    var texte = await r.text();
    if (texte.trim().substring(0,1) === '<') throw new Error('Réponse HTML');
    return JSON.parse(texte);
  } catch(e) {
    var msg = e.name === 'AbortError' ? 'Délai dépassé (' + (delai/1000) + ' s)' : (e.message || 'Erreur réseau');
    throw new Error(msg);
  } finally { if (timeoutId !== null) clearTimeout(timeoutId); }
}

function chargerDepuisCache() { 
  return false;
}
function sauvegarderCache(d) { try { localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(d)); localStorage.setItem(CACHE_TIME_KEY, String(Date.now())); } catch(e) {} }
function viderCache() { try { localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(CACHE_TIME_KEY); } catch(e) {} }
window._jsonpCallback = function(d) { window._jsonpInProgress=false; if (window._jsonpTimeout) { clearTimeout(window._jsonpTimeout); window._jsonpTimeout=null; } var old = document.getElementById('jsonp-script'); if (old) old.remove(); if (!d||!d.ok||!Array.isArray(d.data)) { sync('error',(d&&d.error)?d.error:'Réponse invalide'); setLoader(false); return; } commandes=d.data; sauvegarderCache(commandes); sync('ok','Mis à jour '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})); fillFournisseur(); renderAll(); setLoader(false); };
function charger(force, tent) { if (!force && chargerDepuisCache()) return; if (window._jsonpInProgress && !tent) return; if (window._jsonpTimeout) { clearTimeout(window._jsonpTimeout); window._jsonpTimeout=null; } tent=tent||1; var TIMEOUT_MS = tent>1?60000:45000; window._jsonpInProgress=true; setLoader(true); sync('loading', tent>1?'Nouvelle tentative...':'Chargement...'); var old = document.getElementById('jsonp-script'); if (old) old.remove(); window._jsonpTimeout = setTimeout(function() { if (!window._jsonpInProgress) return; window._jsonpInProgress=false; var s = document.getElementById('jsonp-script'); if (s) s.remove(); if (tent<2) charger(true, tent+1); else { var cached=null; try { cached=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY)||'null'); } catch(e){viderCache();} if (Array.isArray(cached)) { commandes=cached; sync('warn','Serveur lent · cache'); fillFournisseur(); renderAll(); } else { document.getElementById('table-body').innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="14"><div class="empty-state"><p>❌ Serveur trop lent.</p></div></td></tr>'; } setLoader(false); } }, TIMEOUT_MS); var script = document.createElement('script'); script.id='jsonp-script'; script.src = WEBAPP + '?callback=_jsonpCallback&t=' + Date.now(); document.head.appendChild(script); }
function setLoader(on) { document.getElementById('loader').classList.toggle('active',on); }
function sync(state,label) { document.getElementById('sync-label').textContent=label; var d = document.getElementById('sync-dot'); d.className='sync-dot'+(state==='loading'?' loading':''); d.style.background=state==='ok'?'#2E7D32':state==='error'?'#D32F2F':'#E65100'; }

function renderKPI() { 
  var grid = document.getElementById('kpi-grid'); 
  grid.innerHTML='';

function sortBy(col){if(sortCol===col)sortAsc=!sortAsc;else{sortCol=col;sortAsc=true;}renderTable();}
function setFilter(f){alertFilter=f;['all','urgent','warn','ok'].forEach(function(k){document.getElementById('fb-'+k).classList.toggle('active',k===f);});document.getElementById('fb-sav').classList.toggle('sav-active',f==='sav');document.getElementById('fb-noncmd').classList.toggle('noncmd-active',f==='noncmd');renderTable();}
function afficherObjetParLigne(e,ligne){if(e)e.stopPropagation();var c=commandes.find(function(x){return x.ligne===ligne;});if(!c||!c.objetCommande)return;afficherObjet(null,c.objetCommande);}

// ── MODULE FLOTTE ──
async function chargerFlotte() {
  var container = document.getElementById('flotte-alertes');
  if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#78909C;">⏳ Chargement de la flotte...</div>';
  try {
    var response = await apiPost({ action: 'lireVehicules' });
    if (response && response.ok && Array.isArray(response.data)) {
      flotteVehicules = response.data;
    } else {
      flotteVehicules = [];
      var msg = (response && response.error) ? response.error : 'Réponse invalide du serveur';
      if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;text-align:center;padding:20px;">⚠️ Erreur serveur : ' + msg + '</div>';
      return;
    }
    renderFlotte(); 
  } catch(e) { 
    console.warn("Erreur chargement flotte :", e.message); 
    if (container) container.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;text-align:center;padding:20px;">❌ Impossible de contacter le serveur : ' + e.message + '</div>';
  }
}

function renderFlotte() {
  var containerAlertes = document.getElementById('flotte-alertes');
  var containerOK = document.getElementById('flotte-ok-list');
  var btnToggleOK = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-ok');
  if (!containerAlertes) return;

  if (!flotteVehicules || !Array.isArray(flotteVehicules) || flotteVehicules.length === 0) {
    containerAlertes.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:30px;color:#2E7D32;font-weight:600;">🟢 Aucun véhicule enregistré ou la feuille VEHICULES est vide.</div>';
    if (containerOK) containerOK.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  var aujourdhui = new Date();
  var listeUrgents = [];
  var listeAttention = [];
  var listeOK = [];

  flotteVehicules.forEach(function(v) {
    var alertesVehicule = [];
    var infosIntervention = [];

    if (v.urgence === 'haute' && v.description) {
      alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: '🚨 ACTION URGENTE : ' + (v.type || 'Panne') + ' — ' + v.description });
    }

    if (v.prochainCT) {
      var dateCT = new Date(v.prochainCT);
      var joursCT = Math.ceil((dateCT - aujourdhui) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      if (joursCT < 0) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: 'Contrôle technique expiré depuis ' + Math.abs(joursCT) + ' jours' });
      else if (joursCT <= 30) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: 'Contrôle technique dans ' + joursCT + ' jours' });
    } else {
      alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: 'Date de contrôle technique manquante' });
    }

    if (v.kmRevision > 0) {
      var kmDepuisRev = v.kmActuel - v.kmRevision;
      var resteRev = 30000 - kmDepuisRev;
      if (resteRev <= 0) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: 'Révision dépassée de ' + Math.abs(resteRev) + ' km' });
      else if (resteRev <= 2000) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: 'Révision dans ' + resteRev + ' km' });
    }

    if (v.type && (v.type.toUpperCase() === 'PNEUS' || v.type.toUpperCase().indexOf('PIÈCES') !== -1)) {
      var estRecent = false;
      if (v.dateIntervention) {
        var dateInter = new Date(v.dateIntervention);
        var joursDepuis = Math.ceil((aujourdhui - dateInter) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        
        if (joursDepuis < 30 && joursDepuis >= 0) {
          estRecent = true;
          alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 0, txt: '✅ ' + v.type + ' FAITS RÉCEMMENT (il y a ' + joursDepuis + ' j)' });
        } else {
          var moisDepuis = (aujourdhui.getFullYear() - dateInter.getFullYear()) * 12 + (aujourdhui.getMonth() - dateInter.getMonth());
          if (moisDepuis >= 60) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: v.type + ' à changer (plus de 5 ans)' });
          else if (moisDepuis >= 55) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: v.type + ' à prévoir (bientôt 5 ans)' });
        }
      }
      
      if (!estRecent && v.kmIntervention > 0) {
        var kmDepuis = v.kmActuel - v.kmIntervention;
        if (kmDepuis >= 40000) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: v.type + ' usés (' + kmDepuis + ' km)' });
        else if (kmDepuis >= 38000) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: v.type + ' à prévoir (' + kmDepuis + ' km)' });
      }
    }

    if (v.dateAssurance) {
      var dateAssur = new Date(v.dateAssurance);
      var joursAssur = Math.ceil((dateAssur - aujourdhui) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      if (joursAssur < 0) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 3, txt: 'Assurance expirée !' });
      else if (joursAssur <= 30) alertesVehicule.push({ sev: 2, txt: 'Assurance à renouveler dans ' + joursAssur + ' jours' });
    }

    if (v.type || v.description || v.dateIntervention) {
      var badgeUrgence = v.urgence === 'haute' ? '🔴 <strong>URGENT</strong> : ' : '🔧 ';
      var txt = badgeUrgence + '<strong>' + h(v.type || 'Intervention') + '</strong>';
      if (v.dateIntervention) {
        var d = new Date(v.dateIntervention);
        txt += ' le ' + d.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR');
      }
      if (v.kmIntervention > 0) txt += ' à ' + v.kmIntervention + ' km';
      if (v.description) txt += '<br><span style="color:#333;">« ' + h(v.description) + ' »</span>';
      
      if (v.type && v.dateIntervention && Math.ceil((aujourdhui - new Date(v.dateIntervention)) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) < 30) {
         txt = '✅ ' + txt.replace('🔧 ', '');
      }
      
      infosIntervention.push(txt);
    }

    if (alertesVehicule.length > 0) {
      var severiteMax = Math.max.apply(null, alertesVehicule.map(function(a) { return a.sev; }));
      if (severiteMax === 3) listeUrgents.push({ v: v, alertes: alertesVehicule, infos: infosIntervention });
      else if (severiteMax === 2) listeAttention.push({ v: v, alertes: alertesVehicule, infos: infosIntervention });
      else listeOK.push({ v: v, alertes: alertesVehicule, infos: infosIntervention });
    } else {
      listeOK.push({ v: v, infos: infosIntervention });
    }
  });

  function genererCarte(item, type) {
    var color = type === 'urgent' ? 'var(--rouge)' : 'var(--orange)';
    var icon = type === 'urgent' ? '🔴' : '🟠';
    
    var lignesAlertes = item.alertes.map(function(a) {
      var txt = a.txt;
      if (txt.indexOf('ACTION URGENTE') !== -1) {
        return '<li style="font-size:13px; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:700; color:var(--rouge); background:#FFEBEE; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:6px;">' + txt + '</li>';
      }
      if (txt.indexOf('FAITS RÉCEMMENT') !== -1 || txt.indexOf('FAIT RÉCEMMENT') !== -1) {
        return '<li style="font-size:13px; margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:700; color:var(--vert); background:#E8F5E9; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:6px;">' + txt + '</li>';
      }
      return '<li style="font-size:13px; margin-bottom:4px;">' + txt + '</li>';
    }).join('');

    var detailsHtml = '';
    if (item.infos.length > 0) {
      detailsHtml = '<div class="flotte-details-box">' + item.infos.join('<br>') + '</div>';
    }

    var critAirBadge = '';
    if (item.v.critAir) {
      var bgCrit = item.v.critAir==='0'?'#2E7D32':item.v.critAir==='1'?'#8E24AA':item.v.critAir==='2'?'#43A047':item.v.critAir==='3'?'#F57C00':item.v.critAir==='4'?'#AD1457':'#757575';
      critAirBadge = ' <span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; margin-left:6px; color:#fff; background:' + bgCrit + ';">Crit\'Air ' + h(item.v.critAir) + '</span>';
    }

    return '<div class="flotte-alerte-card ' + type + '">' +
      '<div style="flex:1;">' +
        '<div class="flotte-alerte-titre">' + icon + ' ' + h(item.v.id) + ' - ' + h(item.v.modele) + ' <span style="font-size:11px; color:var(--texte2); font-weight:normal;">(' + h(item.v.immat) + ')</span>' + critAirBadge + '</div>' +
        '<ul class="flotte-alerte-liste" style="list-style:none; padding-left:0;">' + lignesAlertes + '</ul>' +
        detailsHtml +
      '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px;">' +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="ouvrirModalVehicule(\'' + item.v.id + '\')" style="border-color:' + color + '; color:' + color + ';">✏️ Mettre à jour</button>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="afficherHistoriqueVehicule(\'' + item.v.id + '\')" style="border-color:var(--bleu); color:var(--bleu);">📜 Historique</button>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  var html = '';
  if (listeUrgents.length > 0) {
    html += '<div style="margin-bottom:15px;"><div style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--rouge); margin-bottom:8px;">🔴 Urgent (' + listeUrgents.length + ')</div>';
    listeUrgents.forEach(function(item) { html += genererCarte(item, 'urgent'); });
    html += '</div>';
  }
  if (listeAttention.length > 0) {
    html += '<div style="margin-bottom:15px;"><div style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--orange); margin-bottom:8px;">🟠 À prévoir (' + listeAttention.length + ')</div>';
    listeAttention.forEach(function(item) { html += genererCarte(item, 'attention'); });
    html += '</div>';
  }
  
  if (!html && listeOK.length === 0) {
    html = '<div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:var(--vert); font-weight:600; font-size:16px;">🟢 Aucun véhicule enregistré.</div>';
  }
  containerAlertes.innerHTML = html;

  btnToggleOK.style.display = 'none';
  containerOK.style.display = 'block';
  containerOK.style.marginTop = '20px';
  
  if (listeOK.length > 0) {
    var htmlOK = '<div style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--vert); margin-bottom:8px;">🟢 Véhicules à jour (' + listeOK.length + ')</div>';
    htmlOK += listeOK.map(function(item) {
      var detailsHtml = '';
      if (item.infos.length > 0) {
        detailsHtml = '<div style="margin-top:5px; font-size:10px; color:#546E7A;">' + item.infos.join(' — ') + '</div>';
      }
      
      var alerteHtml = '';
      if (item.alertes && item.alertes.length > 0) {
        alerteHtml = '<div style="margin-top:5px; font-size:11px; color:var(--vert); font-weight:700;">' + item.alertes[0].txt + '</div>';
      }
      
      var critAirBadge = '';
      if (item.v.critAir) {
        var bgCrit = item.v.critAir==='0'?'#2E7D32':item.v.critAir==='1'?'#8E24AA':item.v.critAir==='2'?'#43A047':item.v.critAir==='3'?'#F57C00':item.v.critAir==='4'?'#AD1457':'#757575';
        critAirBadge = ' <span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; color:#fff; background:' + bgCrit + ';">Crit\'Air ' + h(item.v.critAir) + '</span>';
      }

      return '<div class="flotte-ok-item" style="opacity:1;">' +
        '<div><strong>' + h(item.v.id) + '</strong> - ' + h(item.v.modele) + ' <span style="font-size:11px; color:var(--texte2);">(' + h(item.v.immat) + ')</span>' + critAirBadge + alerteHtml + detailsHtml + '</div>' +
        '<div style="display:flex; gap:5px;">' +
          '<button class="action-btn" onclick="afficherHistoriqueVehicule(\'' + item.v.id + '\')" title="Historique">📜</button>' +
          '<button class="action-btn" onclick="ouvrirModalVehicule(\'' + item.v.id + '\')">✏️</button>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
    containerOK.innerHTML = htmlOK;
  } else {
    containerOK.innerHTML = '';
  }
}
