<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 512 512'%3E%3Cdefs%3E%3ClinearGradient id='g' x1='0%25' y1='0%25' x2='100%25' y2='100%25'%3E%3Cstop offset='0%25' stop-color='%231976D2'/%3E%3Cstop offset='100%25' stop-color='%230D47A1'/%3E%3C/linearGradient%3E%3C/defs%3E%3Crect width='512' height='512' rx='96' fill='url(%23g)'/%3E%3Ctext x='256' y='220' font-family='Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif' font-size='140' font-weight='900' fill='%23fff' text-anchor='middle'%3EECO%3C/text%3E%3Ctext x='256' y='360' font-family='Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif' font-size='120' font-weight='900' fill='%23FFD600' text-anchor='middle'%3EOUEST%3C/text%3E%3Crect x='106' y='400' width='300' height='6' rx='3' fill='%2390CAF9'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="ECO OUEST">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1565C0">
<title>ECO OUEST — Suivi Commandes</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
:root{--bleu:#1565C0;--bleu-clair:#1976D2;--bleu-bg:#E3F2FD;--rouge:#D32F2F;--orange:#E65100;--jaune:#F9A825;--vert:#2E7D32;--vert-bg:#C8E6C9;--gris:#78909C;--gris-bg:#F5F7FA;--texte:#1A1A2E;--texte2:#546E7A;--bordure:#E0E7EF;--sidebar:90px;}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;background:#F0F4F8;color:var(--texte);min-height:100vh;display:flex;}
.sidebar{width:var(--sidebar);background:var(--bleu);min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:100;}
.sidebar-logo{padding:18px 10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);text-align:center;}
.sidebar-logo span{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
.sidebar-logo small{font-size:9px;color:#90CAF9;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;}
.nav{flex:1;padding:12px 0;overflow-y:auto;}
.nav-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:12px 4px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s;border-left:3px solid transparent;text-align:center;}
.nav-item:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
.nav-item.active{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-left-color:#90CAF9;}
.nav-item .icon{font-size:22px;}
.sidebar-footer{padding:14px 10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-align:center;}
.main{margin-left:var(--sidebar);flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;width:calc(100% - var(--sidebar));}
.topbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:8px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;}
.topbar-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;}
.topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:7px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:all .15s;}
.btn-primary{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;}.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--bleu-clair);}
.btn-outline{background:#fff;color:var(--bleu);border:1.5px solid var(--bleu);}.btn-outline:hover{background:var(--bleu-bg);}
.btn-danger{background:var(--rouge);color:#fff;}
.btn-sm{padding:5px 11px;font-size:12px;}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}
.content{padding:8px 12px;flex:1;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;}
.view{display:none;}.view.active{display:block;}
.loader-bar{height:3px;background:var(--bleu-bg);margin-bottom:12px;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;display:none;}
.loader-bar.active{display:block;}
.loader-fill{height:100%;background:var(--bleu);border-radius:2px;animation:load 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes load{0%{width:0%;margin-left:0}50%{width:60%;margin-left:20%}100%{width:0%;margin-left:100%}}
.sync-info{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.sync-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--vert);display:inline-block;}
.sync-dot.loading{background:var(--orange);animation:pulse .8s infinite;}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}

/* ── KPI & RACCOURCIS ── */
.kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.kpi-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;cursor:pointer;transition:box-shadow .15s;}
.kpi-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.kpi-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--texte2);}
.kpi-value{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;}
.kpi-sub{font-size:9px;color:var(--texte2);}
.kpi-urgent .kpi-value{color:var(--rouge);}.kpi-warn .kpi-value{color:var(--orange);}
.kpi-ok .kpi-value{color:var(--vert);}.kpi-info .kpi-value{color:var(--bleu);}

/* ── FILTRES ── */
.filters-bar{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:6px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.search-input{flex:1;min-width:180px;border:1.5px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:none;}
.search-input:focus{border-color:var(--bleu);}
.select-filter{border:1.5px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:none;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;}
.filter-badge{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:all .15s;}
.filter-badge.all{border-color:var(--bleu);color:var(--bleu);background:var(--bleu-bg);}
.filter-badge.urgent{border-color:var(--rouge);color:var(--rouge);}
.filter-badge.warn{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange);}
.filter-badge.ok{border-color:var(--vert);color:var(--vert);}
.filter-badge.all.active{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.urgent.active{background:var(--rouge);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.warn.active{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.ok.active{background:var(--vert);color:#fff;}
.filter-badge.sav-active{background:#D32F2F !important;color:#fff !important;}
.filter-badge.noncmd-active{background:#E65100 !important;color:#fff !important;}

/* ── TABLEAU OPTIMISÉ ── */
.table-wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);overflow:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 200px);display:block;width:100%;margin-bottom:15px;}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;}
thead th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--gris-bg);box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--bordure);text-align:left;padding:8px 4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--texte2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
thead th:hover{color:var(--bleu);}
td{padding:8px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);vertical-align:middle;font-size:11px;}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr:hover td{background:#F8FBFF;}
.col-client{font-weight:600;min-width:100px;}
.col-mono{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--texte2);}
.col-comment{font-style:italic;color:var(--texte2);white-space:normal;min-width:80px;max-width:120px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;}
.badge-ok{background:var(--vert-bg);color:var(--vert);}
.badge-urgent{background:#FFEBEE;color:var(--rouge);}
.badge-info{background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);}
.alerte-text{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;white-space:normal;min-width:80px;max-width:120px;display:block;line-height:1.2;}
.alerte-ok{color:var(--vert);}.alerte-rouge{color:var(--rouge);}
.alerte-orange{color:var(--orange);}.alerte-jaune{color:#B7860B;}
.action-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:5px;font-size:15px;}
.action-btn:hover{background:var(--gris-bg);}
.scroll-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2);padding:8px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bordure);}

/* ── AUTRES VUES ── */
.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:48px 24px;color:var(--texte2);}
.overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,20,40,.45);z-index:200;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.overlay.open{display:flex;}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;width:640px;max-width:96vw;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2);animation:fadeUp .2s ease;}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.modal-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 28px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.modal-header h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;}
.modal-close{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:var(--gris-bg);cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.modal-body{padding:22px 28px;}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
.form-group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
.form-group.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--texte2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;}
input,select,textarea{border:1.5px solid var(--bordure);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 11px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s;color:var(--texte);}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--bleu);}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:70px;}
.modal-footer{padding:16px 28px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.saving-msg{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);display:none;}
.saving-msg.active{display:block;}
.alert-section{margin-bottom:22px;}
.alert-section-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--texte2);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.dot-badge{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;}
.alert-card{background:#fff;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;}
.alert-card:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.07);}
.alert-card-client{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:3px;}
.alert-card-detail{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);}
.alert-card-comment{font-size:12px;color:var(--bleu);font-style:italic;margin-top:4px;}
.alert-pill{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;align-self:flex-start;}
.dash-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;}
.dash-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);padding:20px;}
.dash-card h4{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--texte2);margin-bottom:14px;}
.bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:12px;}
.bar-label{width:110px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
.bar-track{flex:1;height:8px;background:var(--bordure);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;}
.bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px;}
.bar-count{width:24px;text-align:right;color:var(--texte2);font-weight:600;}
.suivipose-card{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;}
.suivipose-header{padding:14px 18px;background:var(--gris-bg);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.suivipose-client{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;}
.suivipose-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--texte2);}
.suivipose-body{padding:14px 18px;}
.suivipose-poseur{margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);}
.suivipose-poseur:last-child{margin-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0;border-bottom:none;}
.suivipose-poseur-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.suivipose-poseur-avatar{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;}
.suivipose-poseur-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;}
.suivipose-comment{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte);line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--gris-bg);border-radius:8px;border-left:3px solid var(--bleu);}
.suivipose-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);font-style:italic;padding:6px 0;}
.suivipose-date{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;z-index:500;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;max-width:380px;animation:slideIn .3s ease;border-left:4px solid var(--bleu);}
.toast.urgent{border-left-color:var(--rouge);}
.toast.warn{border-left-color:var(--orange);}
.toast.ok{border-left-color:var(--vert);}
.toast-icon{font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;}
.toast-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px;}
.toast-msg{font-size:12px;color:var(--texte2);}
@keyframes slideIn{from{transform:translateX(120%);opacity:0}to{transform:translateX(0);opacity:1}}
.agent-header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1565C0,#0D47A1);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 28px;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}
.agent-header-info h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.agent-header-info p{font-size:13px;opacity:.85;}
.agent-header-date{font-size:12px;opacity:.7;margin-top:4px;}
.agent-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--bleu);border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:inherit;}
.agent-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.agent-btn:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait;transform:none;}
.agent-loader{text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:var(--texte2);}
.agent-loader .spinner{display:inline-block;width:60px;height:60px;border:4px solid var(--bordure);border-top-color:var(--bleu);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 1s linear infinite;margin-bottom:16px;}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
.agent-loader .loader-msg{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--bleu);}
.agent-loader .loader-sub{font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;}
.agent-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.agent-stat{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);text-align:center;}
.agent-stat-value{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;}
.agent-stat-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:var(--texte2);margin-top:4px;}
.agent-resume{background:#F5F7FA;border-left:4px solid var(--bleu);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 18px;margin-bottom:18px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--texte);}
.agent-resume strong{color:var(--bleu);}
.agent-section{margin-bottom:24px;}
.agent-section-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.agent-card{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);border-left:4px solid;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;transition:box-shadow .15s;}
.agent-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.agent-card.sev-3{border-left-color:var(--rouge);}
.agent-card.sev-2{border-left-color:var(--orange);}
.agent-card.sev-1{border-left-color:var(--jaune);}
.agent-card-icon{font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;}
.agent-card-content{flex:1;}
.agent-card-client{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--texte);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.agent-card-ligne{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--texte2);background:var(--gris-bg);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;}
.agent-card-texte{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--texte);margin-bottom:8px;}
.agent-card-action{display:inline-block;background:var(--bleu-bg);color:var(--bleu);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;}
.agent-card-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;align-self:flex-start;}
.agent-card-btn{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;white-space:nowrap;}
.agent-card-btn:hover{background:var(--bleu-clair);}
.menu-burger{display:none;background:none;border:none;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--bleu);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1;}
.menu-mobile-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);z-index:400;animation:fadeIn .2s ease;}
.menu-mobile-overlay.open{display:flex;}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.menu-mobile-panel{background:#fff;width:280px;max-width:85vw;height:100%;overflow-y:auto;animation:slideInLeft .25s ease;}
@keyframes slideInLeft{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
.menu-mobile-header{background:var(--bleu);color:#fff;padding:20px 22px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.menu-mobile-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 22px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bordure);transition:background .15s;color:var(--texte);}
.menu-mobile-item:hover{background:var(--bleu-bg);}
.menu-mobile-item .icon{font-size:22px;width:28px;text-align:center;}

/* ── RESPONSIVE MOBILE ── */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .sidebar{width:52px;}
  .sidebar .nav-item span,.sidebar-logo span,.sidebar-logo small,.sidebar-footer{display:none;}
  .sidebar-logo #version-info{display:none;}
  .main{margin-left:52px;width:calc(100% - 52px);}
  .sidebar-logo{padding:14px 8px;}
  .nav-item{padding:14px 8px;justify-content:center;}
  .nav-item .icon{font-size:20px;}
  .agent-header{padding:16px 18px;}
  .agent-header-info h2{font-size:16px;}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .sidebar{display:none !important;}
  .main{margin-left:0 !important;width:100% !important;}
  .menu-burger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .topbar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;}
  .topbar-title{flex:1;font-size:15px;}
  .topbar-right{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .topbar-right .btn{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex:1;min-width:80px;}
  .content{padding:10px 12px;}
  .filters-bar{flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:10px;}
  .search-input,.select-filter{width:100%;}
  .filter-badge{flex:1;min-width:70px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;padding:6px 8px;}
  .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr);gap:8px;}
  .kpi-card{padding:12px;}
  .kpi-value{font-size:22px;}
  .table-wrap{overflow:visible;}
  
  table:not(.no-responsive) thead{display:none;}
  table:not(.no-responsive), table:not(.no-responsive) tbody, table:not(.no-responsive) tr, table:not(.no-responsive) td{display:block;width:100%;}
  table:not(.no-responsive) tr{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bordure);margin-bottom:10px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
